correctness.summary: A line-graph arm-state count gives exact formulas for both tripod families. Their difference simplifies to 2(d-1)F_{d+1}-3dF_d, which is positive for d>=14 by two base checks and the identity 5F_{d+1}-8F_d=F_{d-5}. Direct enumeration of all edge subsets at n=21 independently gives 55273 versus 55247.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The directly inspected primary source states the contradicted conjecture and reports verification only through n=20. Searches by exact conjecture, candidate families, arXiv/DOI, authors, and synonymous formulations did not locate a prior correction or counterexample.

value.summary: The finding refutes an explicit recent extremal-tree conjecture with an infinite counterfamily, identifies the exact first failure at n=21, and supplies a reusable closed tripod-counting formula.

limitations: No theorem is claimed identifying the true second-largest tree for every n>=21.
The all-tripod scan through n=200 is finite evidence only.
The published-journal full text was not independently inspected in full; the accessible arXiv source contains the conjecture verbatim.
Originality is to the best of our knowledge; differently indexed corrections or observations remain a residual risk.
